**La Hire's theorem**: `p₁` lies on the polar of `p₂` if and only if `p₂` lies on the polar of `p₁`.

files.t: Power of a point (intersecting chords and secants)
files.s: This file proves basic geometrical results about power of a point (intersecting chords and secants) in spheres in real inner product spaces and Euclidean affine spaces.

h.d: The power of a point with respect to a sphere.
Intersecting Chords Theorem (Freek No. 55).
Intersecting Secants Theorem.
The product of distances equals the absolute value of power.
Tangent-Secant Theorem.
A line through a point on a sphere is tangent if and only if the squared distance from the external point to the tangent point equals the power of the point.
